entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Duke Maximilian Emanuel in Bavaria was a German prince of the House of Wittelsbach, and a brother of Elisabeth of Bavaria. He married Princess Amalie of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha in 1875, and had three children with her.
